BL-928 — The onboarder supervisor's not-started branch spawns without reaping siblings, so every supervisor death leaves a PID-1 reconcile poll-loop that outlives it and shares the heartbeat file with the new child
Approval context: Two decisions I made on your behalf, both reversible if you disagree.
The reap runs at supervisor STARTUP only, not on every tick. A sibling can only come into existence when a supervisor dies, so a per-tick host-wide process scan every 2s would buy nothing and would put live-process hunting on the…
BL-928 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-928" (or "reject BL-928 <reason>") to act.
